messages:
Sam H.: fyi - probe on A100s shows kernel selection picking ref_gemm_fp32 for short sequences (<128) even when bf16 path available. Seeing 2-3x slower for chat workloads.

Kai L.: can you paste probe output? which CUDA/driver?

Sam H.: here you go, output from /opt/redwood/bin/gpu_probe --device 0 --summary:
```
$ /opt/redwood/bin/gpu_probe --device 0 --summary
device: A100-SXM4-40GB
sm_version: 8.0
cuda: 11.8
supports_tf32: true
supports_bf16_math: true
supports_fp8: false
tensor_cores: 3
compute_capability: 8.0
```

Sam H.: and runtime log snippet showing what was actually selected:
```
[2026-03-15 10:12:34] kernel_picker: seq_len=64, model=redwood-7b, sm=8.0 -> selected=matmul_ref_fp32, reason="heuristic: small batch fallback"
```

Kai L.: aha - heuristic uses 'sm<8.0 OR bf16_disabled' as gate. Looks like bf16 detect worked but a flag was cleared upstream. Any env vars or node-level overrides?

Maria G.: we had a transient where driver exposes BF16 but cuBLAS path segfaults -> infra temporarily set BF16_DISABLED=true in /etc/redwood/gpu_overrides. Might be sticky for older nodes.

Anya P.: propose: make device detection idempotent at startup and publish a per-device capability vector to the control plane: [sm, bf16, fp8, tensor_core_count, timestamp]. Kernel selection should consult that vector instead of a global boolean. Also add a seq_len-aware rule: if seq_len < 128 and bf16 available prefer the small-matmul-bf16 kernel.

Kai L.: sketch config snippet for the policy DSL:
```
kernel_policy:
  - condition: sm >= 8.0 and bf16 == true and seq_len <= 128
    kernel: small_matmul_bf16_tc
    fallback: matmul_ref_fp32
  - condition: sm >= 8.0 and bf16 == true
    kernel: matmul_bf16_tc
```

Sam H.: +1. Also add a metric 'kernel_pick_mismatch' emitted when the chosen kernel != policy predicted. We can use that for canary telemetry and rollback triggers.

infra-bot: perf-test/1761234567-gpu-probe-run completed: small_matmul_bf16_tc: 3.1ms, matmul_ref_fp32: 9.6ms, delta -68% (faster). test_id=pt-20260315-3 :white_check_mark:

Maria G.: ok can someone send a quick PR to runtime/kernel_picker to re-evaluate detection on node-restart and clear stale env overrides in /etc/redwood/gpu_overrides? Might need a migration job for existing Dedicated nodes.

Anya P.: I'll take it. Will add unit tests for sm edge cases (7.5 -> 8.0) and windowed seq_len heuristics. Also will add an integration test that verifies capability vector is published to the control plane on startup. cc @Kai L.

Kai L.: thanks — please don't flip defaults until we collect kernel_pick_mismatch for 24h on canary cluster. If mismatch rate > 1% we hold.

Sam H.: noted. i'll add a short eval harness to capture small sequence p99 and median for both kernels across the canary fleet.

Maria G.: FYI i'll schedule infra rollback window if needed.

Anya P.: PR in a few hours.

Kai L.: :thumbsup:
